messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: My order was due yesterday and the tracking hasn't moved. I need it for an event tomorrow.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Hello Sam, I'm Jordan. Let me see where it is.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The carrier scan is still showing the regional depot. I can't promise it will arrive tomorrow.

messages.speaker: customer
messages.text: That's disappointing. Is there anything else you can do?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: I can open a carrier trace now and email you an update when they respond. If it doesn't arrive, we can discuss a replacement or refund.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: The trace is open under TR-5932. I'll email you when the carrier responds. Thanks for contacting us.
